profile.headline: Full-Stack Web Developer | ASP.NET, C#, Python, PHP, JavaScript
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Software Developer with 5+ years of experience designing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise web applications in .NET, PHP, Python, and JavaScript environments.

My strength lies in modernizing and enhancing systems: refactoring legacy code, integrating systems, and delivering features that make an impact. I work across the full stack, from designing and implementing database and back-end systems to user-facing interfaces.

I’m comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and I enjoy the challenge of explaining systems from multiple points of view. My strengths lie in attention to detail, analytical skills, and a collaborative approach to work. I strive for continuous improvement and lifelong learning.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
•   Eliminated intermittent portal crashes by diagnosing that the on-premises Windows server storage was 99% full. Subsequently identified and fixed a bug that duplicated user-uploaded videos. Reclaimed 50% of storage by purging duplicated videos
•   Safeguarded the portal’s orphaned codebase, which consisted of 95k PHP lines of code, by migrating it to GitHub and establishing version control practices to enable collaborative development and reliable deployments
•   Modernized the portal’s codebase by upgrading PHP from end-of-life 8.1 to 8.5, using AI coding tools to ensure all breaking changes listed in the official documentation were addressed
•   Developed an admin CRUD system for therapy topic management, which replaced manual database modification of therapy topics
•   Modernized the portal’s codebase by upgrading PHP from end-of-life 8.1 to 8.5, using AI coding tools to ensure all breaking changes listed in the oﬃcial documentation were addressed
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Windows Server · Apache Web Server · On-call Support · MySQL

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•   Refactored the authentication system and fixed long-standing bugs by adopting an object-oriented design and reducing the codebase from 5,000 to 1,000 lines of code
•   Reduced report modification time by 97% (from 5 weeks to under 5 hours) by migrating the student portfolio generator from XSLT/FOP to a custom object-oriented architecture built on Aspose.Words
•   Established site-wide ASP.NET API infrastructure and code conventions to support user actions without reloading the page, enabling more fluid interactions for a system with 2,000,000 total accounts
•   Responded to an after-hours emergency email, resolving a critical production bug to prevent a confidential cross-user data leak
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft SQL Server · Scrum · ASP.NET Web Forms · Design Patterns · Git · Visual Studio · Cursor AI

positions.description: •   Engineered a code-quality visualization tool for a research proof-of-concept, resolving browser memory bottlenecks across 10,000+ files by implementing selective DOM rendering and API calls
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Django · Apache Web Server · OAuth · Python (Programming Language)
